visualReview.notes: Inspected11 current portable views,including the retained1024×640 summary. The long stepped compound combines a contemporary northern street frontage with a pale grand frame,original coarse gold diamonds around a broad round arch,vertical pale ribs and recessed opaque glazing,round-headed flanking fields and ground bays;low connecting blocks;and an angular southern prayer hall with tall rectangular green glazing,grey stone strips,round recessed ground bays,a silver ribbed dome,two closed glazed roof turrets and a small front-wing cupola. Gray strips were moved in front of the wall surface after the first rendered inspection. Fine inscriptions,exact decorative motifs,neighboring buildings,garden,fence,vehicles and furnished interiors are omitted. Source-terrain ground contact uses the standard coarse DEM and a seated fixture,not surveyed finished levels.
